items.title: Sam Darnold: Trending toward Week 12 return
items.text:
Coach Mike Macdonald noted ahead of Seattle's Week 11 bye that the team is "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) is "going to be able to get a full week's worth of work and be able to play" Nov. 29 against the 49ers, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tommy DeVito: Could continue to fill in for Maye
items.text:
Mike Reiss of ESPN notes via ESPN's Adam Schefter that there are fears  DeVito's teammate, Drake Maye, may have sustained a fractured ankle during Week 10 action.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Willis: TBD on whether surgery is needed
items.text:
Coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that it has yet to be determined whether Willis (abdomen) will need surgery to address his groin/core injury.David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drake Maye: Not expected to be available after bye
items.text:
Coach Mike Vrabel noted of Maye (ankle) on Monday, "I wouldn't imagine him being available coming out of the bye," Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Omar Cooper: Headed for imaging on ankle
items.text:
Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Cooper (ankle) will undergo imaging Monday, Eric Allen of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
